source.report: Messerschmitt Augsburg 109 10 L 43, 16 June 1943. Plates dated 15 June.
source.locator: PDF pp. 7–8, printed Blatt 7 (climb) and 8 (cooling). The prose refers to pages 6–7. The grid and open circles are visible in both reproductions of the climb plate.
source.lineage: one reported climb campaign; 13 and 14 May flight dates. Individual traces are not assigned to a specific sortie.

conditions.cooling: Sand filter installed, radiator manually adjusted for roughly 100 °C coolant. The plotted temperature is corrected to standard outside air temperature. The report's conditioned benchmark uses the run 3b configuration and transferred engine/cooling inputs.
conditions.role: Graphical checks outside the level-speed fit. The rates, elapsed times, airspeeds and cooling observations belong to the same campaign. Zero independent repeat climbs identified.

calibration.pixels: Top-left origin; PDF p. 7 renders at 1694 × 1800 and p. 8 at 1235 × 1800. Use the actual horizontal altitude grid line at each nominal height; the p. 7 ordinate is nonuniform.
calibration.uncertainty: Estimated read precision, not an instrument or atmospheric error model. Through 10 km: ±0.2 m/s, ±0.2 min (±0.4 min at 10 km), ±3 km/h TAS. At 11 km the elapsed trace is nearly horizontal and the speed trace is unavailable; only an approximate rate is retained (±0.3 m/s). Cooling ±1 °C, ±5 mm and ±0.05 km away from steps. For a symbol's altitude on Blatt 7 interpolate only between its two adjacent labelled grid lines. Slight paper skew shifts the origin a few pixels.

climb.kind: centre of printed curves at labelled heights; the zero-time origin is a convention, not a scored timing observation

rateSymbols.kind: Selected centres of visible open-circle rate observations. Some differ visibly from the smoothed curve. Same evidence lineage; excluded from aggregate scoring.

cooling.kind: Coolant shows original circular observations. Radiator opening is read inside each plotted step. Neither series is fitted or converted into drag.
